Versioned microVM profiles (an image, vCPUs and memory, variables, a setup script and egress) that Kantel builds once and snapshots, so their sandboxes restore instead of booting; and the base channels they follow.

:::caution
Experimental: a deployment serves these only with `KANTEL_TEMPLATES=experimental`.
:::

## List templates

`GET /v1/templates` (SDK method `listTemplates`)

The account's templates, oldest first, each with its build. With `baseDigest`, only those built from or pinned to that base. A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | string | no | The account to act in: the caller's personal account (the default for a person) or an organisation they belong to. An API key always acts in its own account, and naming another is `forbidden`. |
| `baseDigest` | string | no | Only those with a snapshot built from this base digest, or pinned to it. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [TemplateList](/api/reference/types/#templatelist) (`application/json`). The templates.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create a template

`POST /v1/templates` (SDK method `createTemplate`)

A template at version 1, named uniquely in the account. Its snapshot builds in the background on each kind of host the account may use; until one is ready, sandboxes made from it boot its image and run its setup themselves. A Dockerfile or image reference is built first, on a host that builds custom images: its sandboxes wait for that build (`unavailable` until then), as nothing else holds the image. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry is `conflict` (`details.idempotencyKey` `in_progress`): retry it later. A first call that didn't finish (it failed part way, or stopped answering) is never done again under its key: a retry is `conflict` (`held`), so check, then use a new key. The same key with a different request is `refused`. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [CreateTemplateBody](/api/reference/types/#createtemplatebody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Template](/api/reference/types/#template) (`application/json`). The template.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `409` conflict, `422` refused, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a template

`GET /v1/templates/{templateId}` (SDK method `getTemplate`)

With its build, and how far behind a pinned base is. A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `templateId` | string | yes | The template's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Template](/api/reference/types/#template) (`application/json`). The template.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change a template

`PATCH /v1/templates/{templateId}` (SDK method `updateTemplate`)

Renames it or changes its description; a new `spec` makes the next version, which builds in the background. Sandboxes start only from a snapshot of the template's current version, so they boot fresh until it's ready; a Dockerfile's or image reference's wait for the new version's image to build. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `templateId` | string | yes | The template's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateTemplateBody](/api/reference/types/#updatetemplatebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Template](/api/reference/types/#template) (`application/json`). The template.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Delete a template

`DELETE /v1/templates/{templateId}` (SDK method `deleteTemplate`)

Deletes it, its versions and its built snapshots. Sandboxes made from it keep running. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `templateId` | string | yes | The template's ID. |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Deleted.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List a template's snapshots

`GET /v1/templates/{templateId}/snapshots` (SDK method `listTemplateSnapshots`)

Its built snapshots and builds, newest first, discarded ones included: a cache, not the account's snapshots. A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `templateId` | string | yes | The template's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [TemplateSnapshotList](/api/reference/types/#templatesnapshotlist) (`application/json`). Its snapshots.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Rebuild a template

`POST /v1/templates/{templateId}/rebuild` (SDK method `rebuildTemplate`)

Builds its snapshots again, failed ones included. A ready one is kept, stale, and sandboxes go on starting from it until its replacement is ready, and after a rebuild that fails; with none, they boot fresh until the new ones are ready, or, for a Dockerfile or image reference, wait for its image to build. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `templateId` | string | yes | The template's ID. |

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry is `conflict` (`details.idempotencyKey` `in_progress`): retry it later. A first call that didn't finish (it failed part way, or stopped answering) is never done again under its key: a retry is `conflict` (`held`), so check, then use a new key. The same key with a different request is `refused`. (at most 255 characters) |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Template](/api/reference/types/#template) (`application/json`). The template, building.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `422` refused, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List base images' channels

`GET /v1/template-bases` (SDK method `listTemplateBases`)

Every base channel templates may follow, with the digests it has published. Any signed-in caller. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Answers**

- `200`: [TemplateBaseList](/api/reference/types/#templatebaselist) (`application/json`). The channels.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Publish a base image's digest

`POST /v1/template-bases` (SDK method `publishTemplateBase`)

Makes `digest` the channel's current one, made if it is new. Every template following the channel rebuilds in the background; pinned ones don't, and say how far behind they are. A deployment super-admin only (a key needs `hosts:admin`). Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned templates on (`KANTEL_TEMPLATES`).

**Body**: [PublishTemplateBaseBody](/api/reference/types/#publishtemplatebasebody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [TemplateBaseChannel](/api/reference/types/#templatebasechannel) (`application/json`). The channel.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
